notifications.title: Thank you for using Thingport
notifications.body: Thanks for using Thingport! From now on, major updates and new features will be announced here, in the System tab of your notifications.

notifications.title: Thingport 1.0.0 is out
notifications.body: The first stable release brings a remade administration panel, single sign-on providers, and many bug fixes and UI improvements. Update to get them.

entries.title: Welcome to Thingport 1.0.0
entries.body: Thanks for updating to the first stable release! Run a system health check in Administration to make sure everything is set up right. From now on, releases will come less often but pack more changes.

entries.title: Welcome to Thingport 1.1.0
entries.body: Thanks for updating! This release fixes a lot of bugs and adds seven new providers: MyMiniFactory, Thangs, Cults3D, Creality Cloud, Snapmaker Space, MakerOnline and NexPrint. You can now act on many models at once with bulk actions, import with a bookmarklet, and add more panels to your dashboard.

entries.title: Thingport 1.4.0 is out
entries.body: Tools — small apps that work with your library, with nine to install and an editor to write your own. Models that came with their script can be customized and generated again in your browser, multicolour models reach your slicer in their own colours, Thingport Grab pairs instead of saving a password, and CGTrader, GrabCAD, OwlCAD, Toymakr3D and Makerables join the sites you can import from.
